mapper.insert: insert into productline(USERUNIQUE, FACTORYID, PRODUCTLINETYPE, STATUS, FINISHPERIOD, PRODUCTNAME, PRODUCTFINISHPERIOD, SELLPRICE) values (#{userUnique}, #{factoryId}, #{productLineType}, '0', '0', #{productName}, '0', '0');
mapper.select: select p.PRODUCTLINEID, p.FACTORYID, p.PRODUCTLINETYPE, p.STATUS, p.PRODUCTNAME, p.PRODUCTFINISHPERIOD, p.FINISHPERIOD, p.SELLPRICE, b.SETUPPERIODPRICE, b.SETUPPERIOD, b.PRODUCEPERIOD, b.CHANGEPERIOD, b.CHANGECOST, b.MAINCOST, b.DEPRECiATION, b.DELAYTIME from productline as p left join productlinebasic as b on p.PRODUCTLINETYPE = b.PRODUCTLINETYPE where USERUNIQUE = #{userUnique} and FACTORYID = #{factoryId};
